capabilities.title: MAAP test and evaluation
capabilities.text: The briefing describes technology assessment, test planning, safety cases, operator training, custom aircraft design and airworthiness review. MAAP can match a research mission to a site, mobile operations resources and the appropriate approval pathway. BVLOS arrangements, observers, chase aircraft and external FAA/FCC coordination are project-specific, not blanket privileges for map users.
capabilities.source_file: MAAP Overview and C-UAS briefing.pptx, slides 6-12 and 19-26

capabilities.title: Counter-UAS Testing and Research Center at Kentland
capabilities.text: The briefing describes a 14-by-50-ft test management building, a 20-by-25-ft equipment platform elevated 20 ft with power and internet, secure equipment storage and mobile-system hookups. A diverse drone library supports repeatable sensor trials and comparison of sensor tracks with aircraft truth data. Example metrics include detection probability, useful range, track accuracy, latency, false/usable alerts, data quality and human factors. Terrain and time-of-day scenarios help assess performance outside a laboratory. The 2,300-m circle in a slide is a scenario illustration, not a published sensor guarantee or flight boundary.
capabilities.source_file: MAAP Overview and C-UAS briefing.pptx, slides 14-26

capabilities.title: Smart Airspace network
capabilities.text: The September 2026 briefing describes three nodes linked through an IFR-integration research program: Virginia Tech 8VA2 (private, prior permission required), Blackstone KBKT and a temporary Roanoke KROA demonstration site. VTTI site improvements, state licensing and flight validation were reported complete, with its instrument-procedure package submitted to the FAA. Blackstone approach and departure procedures were reported activated March 19, 2026. Roanoke was described as temporary, with a permanent location not established. The briefing reports Aerosonde flights in July and Electra EL2 flights in September 2026. Procedure submissions, flight demonstrations and a functioning public commercial service are different milestones. Proprietary approach designs and operational waypoints are not reproduced here.
